subject: POC orchestration: success KPIs, gated milestones, and handoff owners
messages:
From: mina.haddad@redwood.ai
To: samira.khan@novumhealth.com
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC orchestration: initial recap & proposed success KPIs

Hi Samira —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and a proposed lightweight structure so we can move from discovery into a short, measurable POC. High-level ask: can we align on 3 success KPIs and owners by EOW?

What I heard from your team:
- Core goal: reduce manual triage time for clinical notes by ~40% while preserving recall for urgency labels.
- Data: you can provide a de-identified sample (50k notes) and a small production mirror for inference testing.
- Timeline: 4-week POC, start as early as 4/19 if procurement clears.

Proposed POC structure (short):
1) Success KPIs (example) — Precision on urgent labels >= 92%, inference 95th percentile latency < 300ms, and false-negative rate < 3% on urgent set.
2) Milestones (gated) — Week 0: data intake & infra; Week 1: baseline model run + acceptance test; Week 2: optimized inference + integration smoke tests; Week 4: readout + decision.
3) Owners — Novum: Samira (clinical PM), Tom (infra), Procurement contact. Redwood: Mina (program lead), Ben (integration engineer), Aditya (commercial/terms).

Attached: a one-page success criteria workbook and a draft POC runbook (skeleton). Please scan and tell me which KPI you want to keep, relax, or add.

Next steps (ask):
- Samira/Tom: confirm KPI set or propose edits by Thu 4/15 EOD.
- Novum procurement: share PO or contracting timeline (cc’d if needed).
- Redwood: will prepare an infra checklist and a short runbook update once KPIs land.

Thanks — looking forward to keeping the momentum.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Novum_POC_success_criteria_v1.xlsx; Redwood_POC_runbook_v1.docx

From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@novumhealth.com>
To: mina.haddad@redwood.ai
Cc: t.ellis@novumhealth.com, procurement@novumhealth.com
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 11:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC orchestration: initial recap & proposed success KPIs

Mina —

Thanks for the clear recap and the workbook. Quick replies inline: 

- KPIs: we like the suggested three but want to relax latency to 350ms for the first run (our internal infra will be tuned in Week 2). Precision and false-negative targets look reasonable.
- Milestones: happy with the gate cadence; can we add a short "security checklist" gate at Week 0.5 so InfoSec can sign off on de-id process?
- Owners: confirmed. Tom will handle data & infra prep; I will route procurement updates to procurement@novumhealth.com.

We should be good to start 4/19 assuming procurement clears. I’ll try to confirm by Thu 4/15 as requested.

Also attached a short internal note on data de-identification requirements — we can share specifics once we confirm the sample transfer method.

Cheers,
Samira Khan
VP Product, Clinical AI
Novum Health

Attachment: novum_deid_notes.pdf

From: mina.haddad@redwood.ai
To: ben.carter@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Cc: samira.khan@novumhealth.com
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: POC orchestration: KPIs confirmed (latency relax) — next ops items

Ben / Aditya —

FYI: Novum relaxed latency to 350ms for first pass and asked for an InfoSec gate after initial intake. Can you take the two action items below?

Ben: create an initial infra checklist for Novum’s mirror environment (network egress, auth, de-id finger checks, sample ingestion method). Aim for a 1-pager by 4/16 EOD.
Aditya: draft a simple SOW paragraph (term = 4 weeks, acceptance criteria = KPIs workbook) and a procurement timeline note we can share with their procurement team.

I’ve attached the workbook they reviewed. Looping Samira so she can see owners.

Thanks — Mina

--- Forwarded attachment: Novum_POC_success_criteria_v1.xlsx ---

From: ben.carter@redwood.ai
To: mina.haddad@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Cc: samira.khan@novumhealth.com
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: POC orchestration: KPIs confirmed (latency relax) — infra checklist

Mina / Team —

Draft infra checklist (summary):
- Ingestion: secure S3 transfer (pre-signed URL) + checksum verification; sample size 50k notes (JSONL).
- Auth: temporary service account with scoped keys; token rotation guidance.
- Network: egress rules to Redwood-only IPs; audit endpoints for pulls.
- De-id review: include a small verification subset (200 records) for manual inspection.
- Performance: target instance profile (4xA10G) for baseline runs; enable async batching for throughput tests.
- Smoke tests: end-to-end inference on a 1k shard within 24 hours of ingest.

I’ll convert this into a 1-pager and drop in the Drive link by 4/16 EOD. Any missing items?

Ben Carter
Integration Lead, Redwood Inference

From: aditya.rao@redwood.ai
To: procurement@novumhealth.com, mina.haddad@redwood.ai
Cc: samira.khan@novumhealth.com
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: SOW snippet + procurement timeline (RDW-4921)

Hi Novum procurement —

I’m Aditya from Redwood’s commercial team. Attached is a short SOW paragraph and suggested procurement timeline for the 4-week POC. Highlights:
- Term: 4 weeks starting on the ingest date; fee: trial credit + success-evaluation charge (see attached).
- Acceptance: KPIs workbook (Precision >=92%, FNR<3%, latency <350ms) and signed acceptance form.
- Contracting: we can do a short MSA addendum + PO. Typical turnaround for a small PO is 5–10 business days; if you need a faster path we can issue a statement of work and operate on mutual-good-faith while paperwork is final.

Please advise preferred next step and if you want a redline session this week.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: SLA_draft_Redwood.pdf

From: mina.haddad@redwood.ai
To: samira.khan@novumhealth.com
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai, procurement@novumhealth.com
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Weekly nudge: quick status + ask (ingest readiness & docs)

Hi Samira / Tom / Procurement —

Quick weekly pulse as we head into the planned 4/19 start: 
- Ingest readiness: Tom, Ben’s checklist is in progress — can you confirm the S3 transfer prep and if your sample will be in JSONL or CSV by Tue 4/20?
- Security gate: Samira, do you have a point person for InfoSec sign-off on the de-id process? We need a 30-minute readout the week of 4/19.
- Procurement: Aditya shared an SOW snippet; can procurement indicate PO timeline or whether a mutual-good-faith start is acceptable?

Ask: please reply with short answers to the three bullets above by EOD Mon 4/19 so Redwood can lock scheduling. If any blocker surfaces we’ll pause start and rebook.

Thanks for the fast turnaround — small asks so we don’t lose momentum.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

P.S. I’ve dropped the infra 1-pager and the updated workbook into the Drive folder (link above).
